title: 3530. Maximum Profit from Valid Topological Order in DAG

examples.explanation: Node 1 depends on node 0, so a valid order is [0, 1]. Node Processing Order Score Multiplier Profit Calculation 0 1st 2 1 2 × 1 = 2 1 2nd 3 2 3 × 2 = 6 The maximum total profit achievable over all valid topological orders is 2 + 6 = 8.

Nodes 1 and 2 depend on node 0, so the most optimal valid order is [0, 2, 1]. Node Processing Order Score Multiplier Profit Calculation 0 1st 1 1 1 × 1 = 1 2 2nd 3 2 3 × 2 = 6 1 3rd 6 3 6 × 3 = 18 The maximum total profit achievable over all valid topological orders is 1 + 6 + 18 = 25.
